discord.leaving_soon.title: The headline of the Discord embed posted when titles enter the Leaving Soon grace window. {count} is the total number of titles in this run, a whole number, before the list below it is trimmed for length.
discord.leaving_soon.body: The first paragraph of the same Discord embed, above the bulleted title list. {grace_days} is a whole number of days.
discord.leaving_soon.more: A fragment appended after the bulleted title list when it was trimmed for length. {remaining} is a whole number: how many more titles are leaving soon but are not listed by name.
discord.leaving_soon.open_link: The link text at the end of the embed, back to this install. {app_name} is the operator's name for their Reaper (Settings, General), not the literal word Reaper.
discord.test.title: The title of the test message Reaper posts to Discord when the operator presses Test on Settings, Notifications. A whole sentence, no params.
discord.test.body: The body of that test message. A whole sentence, no params. 'Your users' are the people who watch on the operator's Plex server.
launcher.tray.open: The desktop app's tray/menu-bar icon item that opens Reaper in the browser (Windows tray, macOS menu bar).
launcher.tray.quit: The desktop app's tray/menu-bar icon item that stops the server and closes the icon.
launcher.tray.tooltip: The name shown when hovering the desktop app's tray/menu-bar icon.
launcher.dialog.crashed: A native dialog box shown on the desktop app when the server thread dies unexpectedly.
launcher.dialog.port_in_use: A native dialog box (and the console line before it starts) shown when the port Reaper would bind is already answering. {port} is a whole number, shown twice. {move} is the fragment from launcher.move.conf or launcher.move.env, already composed in this same language.
launcher.dialog.no_migrations: A native dialog box (and the console line before it starts) shown when this install has no migrations folder beside it, which normally means a bare `pip install` outside a supported install shape.
launcher.move.conf: A fragment nested inside launcher.dialog.port_in_use, naming the file a desktop or snap install edits to change the port. {conf} is a file path, shown as the operating system spells it.
launcher.move.env: A fragment nested inside launcher.dialog.port_in_use, naming the environment variable a container or source checkout sets instead. Carries no params.
